content: प्राच्य {%a.%} [प्राचि भवः यत्] .²1 Being or situated in front. .²2 Being or living in the east, eastern, easterly. .²3 Prior, preceding, previous. .²4 Ancient, old. .{@-च्याः@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) .²1 ‘The eastern country’, the country south or east of the river Sarasvatī. .²2 The people of this country.
